members.name: donchian_channel_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Donchian channel (N-bar highest high / lowest low) breakouts capture the start of new intraday trends. Unlike moving average crossovers, Donchian is parameter-light (just one: the lookback) and doesn't whipsaw in rangebound markets because the channel only contracts, never generates false crosses. T
filters: no entry first 30 min or last 30 min
prefer breakouts aligned with nifty EMA(21) direction
weaknesses: 37% win rate is psychologically punishing. 7-10 consecutive losses are expected regularly. Most traders will override the system.
30-bar Donchian on 1-min bars = 30-minute channel. This is quite short — noise-driven breakouts will be frequent.
In rangebound markets, the channel stays tight and generates many small losses as price oscillates just above/below the channel.
members.prior_art: Donchian Channel Breakout. Richard Donchian (1950s). Turtle Trading System. See: Following the Trend (Clenow), Trading Evolved.

members.name: price_channel_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Donchian Channel breakout using a 30-bar lookback on 1-min data captures new 30-minute highs/lows as trend continuation signals. When price breaks above the highest high of the last 30 bars, it has exceeded a natural resistance level and momentum traders pile in. The original Turtle Trading system u
entry_long: DC_width_pct > 0.3 (sufficient range to break out from)
members.exit_target: DC_width_pct projected from breakout point (measured move: breakout_price + DC_width)
members.exit_stop: DC_mid (midline of the channel — if price pulls back to middle, breakout failed)
filters: India_VIX > 14 (need some volatility for breakouts to work); < 30
VWAP direction should align with breakout direction
weaknesses: Low win rate (~40%) is psychologically difficult; many false breakouts, especially in range-bound markets
On 1-min bars, a 30-bar channel is only 30 minutes — breakout significance is lower than daily Donchian channels
Volume spike requirement may cause late entries — by the time volume confirms, the best entry price is gone
